ItemID: unavailable; Title: VENLAB Digital Clamp Meter 1000A T-RMS 6000 Counts AC/DC Current Multimeter, Voltage Tester with Auto-ranging Backlight, Measures Voltage Temperature Capacitance Resistance Frequency Continuity NCV; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: I would choose this for troubleshooting electrical problems alongside my other inspection and measurement tools.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: 4-40 and 6-32 Machine Screws, Nuts and Washer 280 pcs Pan Head Screws #4-40#6-32 - Screws Nuts and Washers Set - Full Thread Small Screws with Storage Box; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: Small imperial screws would complement my metric hardware and help with repairs requiring these thread sizes.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: SOOQOO 50 Pcs KN95 Face Maks for Audlts; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I am focused on workshop hardware right now and have no specific need for these masks.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: Touchless Trash Can,3.2 Gallon Waterproof Automatic Smart Bathroom Garbage Can with Lid, Slim Motion Sensor Plastic Narrow Trash Bin for Bedroom, Kitchen, Office,RV White; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: A small household trash can does not address my current repair or fabrication projects.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: Dong7Niu Endoscope Camera with Light, 2.4 "IPS HD Screen Borescope Inspection Camera, IP67 Waterproof Home Sewer Camera, Snake Camera with 16.5FT Semi-Rigid Cable; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I already have a triple-lens Teslong endoscope, and this does not offer a clear reason to replace it.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: ELOOGAA 3Pcs Solderless Breadboard 830 Point Solderless Prototype PCB Board Kit for Arduino Proto Shield Distribution Connecting Blocks; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: My recent projects involve mechanical fastening and fabrication; I have no circuit-prototyping project in mind.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: Decibel Meter, CURCONSA SPL Meter, Portable Sound Level Meter, 30dB to 130dB, LCD Display, can be Used in Homes, Factories and Streets(Blue); ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I like practical measurement tools, but I do not currently have a noise-measurement task that justifies this one.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: 100 Pc 6"x.045"x7/8" Cut-Off Wheels Lincoln Abrasives Metal & Stainless Steel; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: My recent cutting wheels were five inches; I would skip this large pack without confirming six-inch compatibility with my tool.
